properties.name: White Legs Territory
properties.note: The White Legs are a nomadic tribe known for scalping their enemies. They have never developed self-sufficiency, surviving only by raiding caravans, settlements and other tribes. In 2281, they are hoping to join Caesar's Legion.

properties.name: 80s Territory
properties.note: The 80s are a tribe of raiders that live in northern Nevada, near the shores of the Great Salt Lake. Their territories border with those of their longtime enemies, the White Legs. The 80s are known for raiding frontier towns for supplies and kidnapping people, and are rightly feared for their ability to cover large areas of land with very few men. They have spread out over a large area, notably along I-80 and Highway 50, due to the Nevada Desert Rangers merging with the NCR and their resulting inability to patrol or keep tabs on the territory.

properties.name: Beastlords Territory
properties.note: The Beastlords were a group of cannibalistic tribals who underwent a mutation which gave them psychic control over various creatures. They were fond of poison, which can cause problems for even the most stalwart of bands.

properties.name: Gammorin's Army
properties.note: Gammorin's Army is one of the two most important offshoots of the Master's Army, along with the Attis Army, initially led by a super mutant called Gammorin, and later by ex-Brotherhood of Steel Paladin Latham, who took Gammorin's name as his own.

properties.name: Sorrows Territory
properties.note: The Sorrows are a friendly tribe living in Zion canyon, and are particularly unique as they do not have a warrior-based culture, but rather a hunting-based culture.

properties.name: Midwestern Brotherhood of Steel
properties.note: After the defeat of the Master, the original Brotherhood found themselves at odds with their need for new blood versus their code of technological secrecy. The debate went lightly. Finally, the elders ruled against sharing the technology with outsiders, convinced that they would endure what they had before. Further discussion was discouraged when the elders ordered the minority who wished to share their technology on a mission across the wastes. The Brotherhood constructed airships and dispatched the minority East, to track down and assess the extent of the remaining super mutant threat. However, as they traveled over the great mountains a great storm broke the main airship and flung it far from its course. The mighty airship was badly damaged, the smaller sections were torn from the main craft and never to be seen again. Many of the expedition leaders, including Paladin Latham, were lost to the winds. The fraction of the crew that still survived, struggled to keep their ship aloft before finally crashing on the outskirts of the ruins of Chicago. Survivors eventually formed a new organization, which diverged greatly from the ideals of the old Brotherhood. In time, they established a harsh rule over the towns and villages in that area.

properties.name: Attis's Army
properties.note: Attis Army is one of the two most important offshoots of the Master's Army, along with the Gammorin's Army, led by an old important commander of the Master's Army called Attis.

properties.name: Eastern Brotherhood of Steel
properties.note: The East Coast Brotherhood of Steel is a division of the Brotherhood of Steel and was founded by Elder Owyn Lyons. Their headquarters is the Citadel, an imposing fortress built into and beneath the ruins of the Pentagon on the edge of what used to be Washington, D.C. As of 2287, they are led by Arthur Maxson, the last descendant of the venerated Maxson family line. Under his leadership, the Brotherhood controls the Capital Wasteland and is able to project their power all the way to Boston.

properties.name: Caesar's Legion
properties.note: Caesar's Legion is an autocratic, ultra-reactionary, totalitarian slaver society, founded in 2247 by Edward Sallow (also known as Caesar) and Joshua Graham, and is based on the ancient Roman Empire. Its legionaries are a well organized, culturally insular fighting force that mainly operate east of the Colorado River and the Grand Canyon, in the former state of Arizona. Ever pushing east, their capital is the city of Flagstaff.

properties.name: New California Republic
properties.note: New California (officially the New California Republic, often abbreviated to NCR) is a large, democratic federation based in California, with holdings in Nevada, Mexico (Baja), and along the Colorado River. The NCR emphasizes and claims to support a myriad of old world values, such as democracy, personal liberty, and the rule of law. It also strives to restore general order to the wasteland, the improvement and development of infrastructure and economic systems, and a basic common peace between the people. Though appearing to be a benevolent entity of governance, the ability to control the land it claims to protect, the fidelity of those who live under their rule, and the widespread corruption within their political system has been questioned by many, without a clear response by the NCR themselves.

properties.name: Republic of Dave
properties.note: The Republic of Dave is a small farming settlement in the far northeastern corner of the Capital Wasteland that is considered by its close-knit inhabitants to be a sovereign nation-state. In earlier years, it was known as the Kingdom of Tom before being taken over by its current ruler, Dave, who subsequently allowed voting, and thus it became a republic.

properties.name: The Kings
properties.note: The Kings are a gang that controls the district of Freeside, north of the New Vegas Strip. They are headquartered within The King's School of Impersonation - a pre-war Elvis Presley impersonation school, which they mistakenly believe was originally a place of worship. The gang is based around the anarchic ideal of complete personal freedom, where "every man is a king in [their] own right", with their leader himself taking upon the title of "The King". Members dress and speak like Elvis once did, though they were never able to learn what his name actually was, due to all traces of it having disappeared long before their time. By 2296, several of their gang members became ghoulified and roamed around the Strip's southern gate. Despite this, the Kings still remain present in Freeside, often hanging out in front of their headquarters.

properties.name: Robert House’s jurisdiction
properties.note: Robert House’s jurisdiction of the New Vegas strip began in 2274, upon his restoration of the city and recruitment of three local tribes to run his casinos. He signed the Treaty of New Vegas with the NCR to allow co-existence between the two parties, with terms stating the NCR could maintain an embassy within the strip and that soldiers stationed in the Mojave could visit the casinos. Additionally, any soldiers on the strip were not to be under the jurisdiction of House’s securitrons, but rather NCR military police. By 2281, the NCR wants to annex the Mojave, including the city itself, while House is seeking to legitimize his control of the strip as its own sovereign entity called the Free Economic Zone of New Vegas.

properties.name: Rippers Territory
properties.note: The Rippers are an ultra-violent gang from the Boneyard, prone to violently attacking anything and anyone not related to them, and as such are at war with the Blades. Their former warehouse hideout became infested with deathclaws, which all but wiped them out. A few members likely survived and regrouped, as they are said to still be operating in the western Boneyard. ** Depicted territory is speculated. **

properties.name: Fiends Territory
properties.note: The Fiends are a loose group of crazed chem addicts living in the region southwest of the Strip. They are led by Motor-Runner, based out of Vault 3, whose inhabitants they slaughtered.

properties.name: Blades Territory
properties.note: The Blades are a group of survivalists located within a particularly sketchy region of the Boneyard known as "downtown". They are led by a woman named Razor and take their name from Blades-brand razor advertisements on the walls of their headquarters.

properties.name: Dead Horse Territory
properties.note: The Dead Horses are a tribe in Utah descendant of refugees from Dead Horse Point State Park. The Dead Horses were taught how to maintain weapons and how to fight, among other things, by Joshua Graham, whom they both feared and admired.

properties.name: Blue Ridge Caravan Company
properties.note: The Blue Ridge Caravan Company started as a pre-war trucking business that operated primarily along the Blue Ridge Parkway. After the Great War in 2077, they simply switched out trucks for brahmin and continued business otherwise. By 2103, they had secured the entire parkway, making it one of the safest possible routes for travelers and merchants.

properties.name: The Slags
properties.note: The Slags are the descendants of a group of secret militia officers who sealed themselves underground and slowly mutated. The population steadily increased and it soon became apparent that they could no longer survive underground without further supplies. A small farm was created above their home at some point prior to 2241.

properties.name: Maud's Muggers
properties.note: Maud's Muggers are a group of elderly women wielding rolling pins who mug passerby in Freeside. ** Appears via the Wild Wasteland perk. **

Jaggers Territory
properties.note: The Jaggers are a raider tribe operating in the New Reno area, having formed from Great War survivors living in logging camps throughout the Tahoe and Sierra mountains. They take their name from jaggers, which are short pieces of wire used in logging, due to the tribe also using such wires to make traps and craft decorations. The Jaggers continue to live within old timber camps - moving from location to location over the years - and have become a local legend. By the late 23rd century, they began occasionally hitting caravans. In 2280, they have secretly taken over the settlement of Tahoe and are attempting to seize control of the region. ** The Jaggers are mentioned in the Royal Flush sourcebook for the Fallout tabletop RPG. Depicted territory is speculated. **

properties.name: Mormons
properties.note: ** The Mormons are mentioned in the Royal Flush sourcebook for the Fallout tabletop RPG. **

properties.name: Green Thumbs
properties.note: The Green Thumbs are a raider group. Unlike others, they only raid to survive and do not revel in the violence. While they initially traveled from location to location due to their inability to grow crops, they eventually stumbled across a pre-war military training base and decided to begin a weapon-dealing business out of it. A deal was made with the New California Republic: they received pardons and retained the ability to independently trade in exchange for handing over several pre-war military training tapes inside the installation.
